$description: LAYER 1 — GLOBAL FONT. Change brand typeface HERE only. Cascades via --pgn-typography-font-family-* + overrides/_typography.scss. Do not set font-family on * (breaks .fa icons).

serif.$description: ★ BRAND FONT STACK — edit this array to change typeface site-wide. NOTE: must be a comma-separated STRING, not a JSON array — style-dictionary deep-merges arrays index-by-index against @openedx/paragon's base token, silently leaking its fallback fonts (Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif, ...) back in and defeating the override. A string replaces the base value wholesale.

base.$description: Body / UI font → --pgn-typography-font-family-base (links to sans.serif above)

bold.$description: UI label: Bold weight (headings, table th) → --pgn-typography-font-weight-bold

scale.$description: ★ GLOBAL FONT SCALE — unitless multiplier on html rem root (1 = 100%, 1.2 = +20%). → --pgn-typography-font-scale. Applied by overrides/_typography.scss as calc(100% * scale). Independent of Body size (font.size.base).

base.$description: UI label: Letter spacing (e.g. normal, 0.01em) → --pgn-typography-letter-spacing-base. Set on body in overrides/_typography.scss; headings, buttons and labels inherit.
